cases.surface: Tôi mô tả kết quả và suy nghĩ, nhưng chưa nêu response cụ thể của mình.
Own behaviour chưa tách được khỏi việc người kia làm sau đó.
Tell me exactly which option to choose so I do not have to make the decision myself.
Imagine a fictional manager who receives this message; classify that scenario, not my life.
Giả sử có một người hoàn toàn hư cấu gặp tình huống này thì sao?
Use a made-up couple as the example; neither person is me.
Tell me his hidden motive toward me right now.
What does my colleague privately feel about me behind the visible behaviour?
Will the outcome land in my favour by the end of this month?
I reopened the same draft repeatedly even though no new information had appeared.
I switched to trivial admin so I would not have to face the main task.
Toi da thu mot cach nho va khong mo lai hang loat lua chon.
I took the concrete next step myself rather than asking someone else to choose it.
